en.title: Greece signs deal for up to six Embraer KC-390 Millennium aircraft
en.summary: Greece has signed a contract for three Embraer KC-390 Millennium multi-mission aircraft with options for three more, becoming the seventh European nation to select the type, with the first delivery due in 2027.
body: The Hellenic Ministry of National Defense signed a contract on November 2, 2026, to acquire three KC-390 Millennium aircraft with options for an additional three, produced by Embraer through a government-to-government agreement between Greece and Portugal. Under the agreement, the Hellenic Air Force will receive its first KC-390 Millennium in 2027, enhancing its airlift and air-to-air refueling capabilities while strengthening interoperability with NATO and allied forces, with Greece also benefiting from European synergies in training, support, and logistics.

Greece becomes the seventh European nation to select the aircraft, joining Portugal, Hungary, the Netherlands, Austria, the Czech Republic and Sweden. Beyond Europe, the KC-390 Millennium has also been acquired by the air forces of Brazil, the Republic of Korea, the Republic of Uzbekistan, the United Arab Emirates and Colombia. The aircraft can carry more payload (26 tons) than other medium-sized military transport aircraft, flying faster (470 knots) and farther, and can perform cargo and troop transport, equipment and personnel airdrops, medical evacuation, search and rescue, firefighting, and humanitarian missions, operating from temporary or unpaved runways. When configured with quick-installation air-to-air refueling equipment, it can operate both as a tanker and as a receiver.

zh.title: 希臘簽約引進最多6架EmbraerKC-390千禧年運輸機
zh.summary: 希臘國防部簽約採購3架EmbraerKC-390千禧年多用途運輸機並保留增購3架的選擇權，首架預計2027年交付，希臘成為第7個選用此機型的歐洲國家。
body: 希臘國防部於11月2日簽約，透過希臘與葡萄牙之間的政府對政府協議，向Embraer採購3架KC-390千禧年多用途運輸機，並保留再增購3架的選擇權，總數最多6架。根據協議，希臘空軍將於2027年接收首架KC-390，以強化空運與空中加油能力，並提升與北約盟國的互通性，同時在訓練、支援與後勤方面受惠於歐洲協同效益。
希臘是第7個選用KC-390的歐洲國家，此前已有葡萄牙、匈牙利、荷蘭、奧地利、捷克與瑞典；此外，巴西、韓國、烏茲別克、阿拉伯聯合大公國與哥倫比亞的空軍也已採購此機型。KC-390可載運26噸酬載，飛行速度達470節，能執行貨物與部隊運輸、裝備與人員空投、醫療後送、搜救、滅火與人道任務，並可在臨時或未鋪面跑道起降；配備快速安裝的空中加油設備時，既可擔任加油機，也可接受空中加油。
